svg.title: Timeout designs: how each fault ends
svg.text: Timeout designs: how each fault ends
A's last result and the effect on the bus, per fault scenario (rows) and design (columns).
F = 1 s · Smax = 5 ms · Bhold = 14.9 ms · Tmax = 20 ms · tstuck = 100 ms · treset = 50 ms (assumed) · byte 11.25 µs · main loop 100 µs (assumed)
bus usable; nothing blocks or owns it longer than Tmax
bus blocked or owned longer than Tmax, then usable again
bus failure reported; failure mode until restart
data may be lost or wrong without an error
bus unusable at the end and nothing reported
Single timer columns differ only in the target stretch limit; figures timeout_<scenario>.svg show the timelines for 50 ms. Layered: the controller firmware is
firmware/txn/txn.c, compiled unchanged. The limits (Smax, Bhold, tstuck, wait after reset, line check, failure mode) follow the spec and the documented platform
capabilities; the bridges do not implement them yet. txn.c has no bus-failure outcome yet: Aborted.
Single timer: model of one supervision timer per transfer (no implementation). Assumed in both designs: a START inside a running transfer cuts it as a bus error (not
